source.note: MBBS at Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College (JNMC), Faculty of Medicine, AMU, from a students' shared Google Drive of previous year papers and study material. '1st/2nd/4th Prof' = 1st, 2nd and final (4th) professional MBBS. Paths: Faculty-of-Medicine/MBBS/Prof-<N>/<course>/<section>; use find_courses. 'Proff Papers B-2019 (2022)' = professional (and terminal) exam papers of the batch admitted in 2019, examined in 2022. Most files are phone photos of printed question papers: name them by year, subject, paper and page. 'Terminal' papers are internal (pre-professional) exams. Folders marked (NEET_INICET) hold NEET-PG/INI-CET exam questions (keep them in Books-and-Resources of the subject). Instruments, drugs, X-rays and spotting photos are practical-exam reference images (Books-and-Resources). Published books (e.g. 'Drug of choice', 'Guljis' notes if they are a published book) are not ours to publish.
